name: Absorb Spell (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Spell resistance

Benefit(s): If a spell or spell-like ability fails to overcome your spell resistance you again a +1 circumstance bonus to your own attack rolls, saves, and skill checks for 1 hour. This bonus increases by 1 every two spell levels, so a 6th level spell such as chain lighting would grant a +4 circumstance bonus. In addition, you gain 5 temporary hp for every two spell levels of the spell. These temporary hit points also last for 1 hour.
